label: Token supply modes
summary: Reusable fixed, capped-mint and burn-only supply-policy checks for an explicitly selected token architecture.
maturityMeaning: Deterministic reusable source is packaged and hash-bound; project integration, tests and review are still required.
requiredFacts: Select one supply mode and bind every mint or burn caller
Bind initial supply, cap, recipient and irreversible authority policy
Define whether transfer, pool and claim flows observe gross or net supply changes
hardConflictPredicates: A fixed-supply declaration retains any callable mint path
A capped-mint path can produce total supply above the immutable cap
A burn path can debit an account without that account or an explicitly disclosed authority
